titolo: Targeting of diplomatic agencies in Eastern Europe
descrizione: Russian threat actor the Dukes targeted embassies and diplomatic agencies in Eastern Europe with a variety of spear-phishing lures. The attacks used a new variety of malware based on an older piece of malware the Dukes had used previously.

titolo: Targeting of government organizations in Eastern Europe and Western Asia
paesi_vittima: Estonia, Greece, Japan, Latvia, Taiwan, Turkey, United States
descrizione: Mustang Panda targeted government and civil-society networks in at least nine countries— including the United States, Greece, Japan, and the United Kingdom—with several new malware droppers.

titolo: Targeting of a defense and cybersecurity organization in the Baltics
descrizione: Russian threat actor Turla targeted defense and cybersecurity organizations in the Baltic states. Turla sent emails to targets, each with unique links that led victims to download a malicious file.

In April 2007, Russia-based attackers launched a series of denial of service attacks against Estonian public and private sector organizations in response to the government’s removal of a Soviet war monument from downtown Tallinn.
